title: Spec Kit Conformance Design
purpose: Settle the constitution article mapping, adapter scope, and command surface naming before story 1–4 implementation begins.

questions.label: Constitution mapping
questions.prompt: Spec Kit's constitution.md has nine articles (goals, tech stack, coding standards, workflow, testing, review, deployment, monitoring, communication). Which of these map cleanly from BUSINESS_RULES.md, and which do we deliberately diverge from or omit? List the articles you want to keep, adapt, or drop.

questions.label: Adapter direction
questions.prompt: Should story 3 (speckit_import) ship in the same release as story 2 (speckit_export), or should we export-only first and defer import? The INTENT success criteria require bidirectional — the question is sequencing.

questions.label: Command names
questions.prompt: Should the slash commands be bare (/specify, /plan, /tasks) or namespaced (/speckit.specify, /speckit.plan, /speckit.tasks)? Bare names are shorter but risk collision with other skills; namespaced names are unambiguous but more typing.
